method: Curated relationships explicitly described by operators or public authorities. Location records are independently matched by facility identity, not proximity. A stated relationship is not independently audited shipment tracing or evidence of current service. Missing quantities remain null. Coverage is a small set of documented networks, not a global supply-chain inventory.
geometry: Lines are schematic endpoint connections. They do not follow roads, railways, pipelines or navigable sea routes. Line width does not encode quantity.

links.scope: Cathodes and concentrate are separate material forms; no quantities or shares are assigned.
